name: EVENTS-001-F03 Repeat events by calendar days or weeks

background.text: the phone time zone is UTC
the phone language is English United States

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S10 Count the first occurrence in a day or week series

steps.text: the owner creates Course at 09:00 starting <start_date> every <interval> <unit> ending after 3 occurrences
Course starts at 09:00 on exactly <start_date>, <second_date> and <third_date>
Course has no occurrence on <next_date>
each timed occurrence lasts 60 elapsed minutes

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S11 Include the recurrence end date

steps.text: the owner creates Course at 09:00 starting <start_date> every <interval> <unit> ending on <end_date>
exactly 3 Course occurrences start from <start_date> through <end_date>
Course starts at 09:00 on <end_date>
Course has no occurrence on <next_date>

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S12 A never-ending series remains available in a later window

steps.text: the owner creates Course at 09:00 starting 2027-01-01 every 1 days ending never
the owner navigates to 2030-01-01 through 2030-01-03
Course starts at 09:00 on each of those 3 dates
its recurrence details still show no end

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S13 Reject a nonpositive or noninteger recurrence interval

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for Course on 2027-02-06
the owner attempts to configure daily recurrence with interval input <interval_input>
recurrence interval input <interval_input> is not accepted
the owner abandons the editor
no event named Course exists

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S14 Reject a nonpositive or noninteger occurrence count

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for Course on 2027-02-06
the owner attempts to end daily recurrence after count input <count_input>
occurrence count input <count_input> is not accepted
the owner abandons the editor
no event named Course exists

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S15 Reject an end date before the first occurrence

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for Course on 2027-02-10
the owner configures daily recurrence ending on 2027-02-09 and attempts to save
the end date is identified as invalid and the editor remains open
the owner abandons the editor
no event named Course exists
